user.title: Connect to a Juniper switch
user.description: The switch needs NETCONF over SSH turned on and a read-only user. See the setup guide in the README. Give either a password or a private key.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the switch's management interface.
data_description.port: 830 unless you changed 'system services netconf ssh port'.
data_description.private_key: Paste the whole key, including the BEGIN/END lines. Leave empty to use a password.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate {host}
reauth_confirm.description:
The switch rejected the stored credentials, or its SSH host key changed (for example after a routing engine replacement or zeroize). Submitting accepts the switch's current host key.

{error}

error.invalid_auth: The switch rejected the username, password or key.
error.netconf_refused: SSH worked but NETCONF is off. On the switch: set system services netconf ssh; commit
error.host_key_changed: The switch's SSH host key does not match the one stored for it.
error.no_credentials: Enter a password or a private key.

abort.already_configured: This switch is already set up.

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between polls. Throughput is averaged over this interval.
data_description.interfaces: Deselect ports you don't care about to keep the entity count down.
